illustrations.composition: A daytime sky diorama: a large ivory crescent Moon in the upper right and a smaller mustard Sun with a few broad paper rays in the upper left, both clearly above a low gently curved lilac and teal local horizon. The crescent is a physical curved layered paper sculpture, not a glowing lamp. No people, animals, faces, stars, writing or night sky. The three astronomical/landscape pieces are widely separated with visible background gaps.
illustrations.drawability_reason: Few separated paper sculpture objects; broad contours precede localized color/shadow fill within measured narration. No human anatomy to fabricate. A registered mask preserves 3D paper appearance without forcing a doodle outline.
illustrations.order_exception: Moon is introduced before source Sun; causal order in reflection follows Moon, Sun, Earth, then directional light ribbons. Background/cardstock stage is last and owns only remaining pixels.

illustrations.composition: A causal sunlight-reflection diorama, not an orbital scale drawing: mustard Sun upper-left, large ivory round Moon upper-right, a small teal Earth globe lower-middle. One broad coral paper arrow goes from Sun to Moon; one broad slate-blue paper arrow goes from Moon down toward Earth. The arrowheads point unambiguously toward Moon and then Earth. Arrows stop at the objects and do not cross them. No faces, people, writing or extra symbols.
